title: Comparison of etale inverse images on affine etale sites
statement: Let $h:T'\to T$ be an affine morphism of schemes [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Base change $u:T_{affine,\Et}\to T'_{affine,\Et}$, $V\mapsto V\times_TT'$, is well defined: the base change of $h$ to an affine etale $V$ is affine, and standard etale coverings base change to standard etale coverings. The functor $u$ is continuous and defines a morphism of affine etale sites $g:T'_{affine,\Et}\to T_{affine,\Et}$, as in clause (1) of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-colimit]. Let $|_{aff}$ denote the restriction equivalence of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-site-topos] for sheaves of sets. For every sheaf of sets $G$ on $T_{\Et}$, there is a natural isomorphism $(h^{-1}G)|_{aff}\cong g^{-1}(G|_{aff})$. This isomorphism carries the unit of $h^{-1}\dashv h_*$ on sections over an affine $V$ to the unit of $g^{-1}\dashv g_*$; for composable affine morphisms $h_a$ and $h_b$ it is compatible with composites, matching $c$ of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] with the canonical isomorphism $g_b^{-1}g_a^{-1}\cong g_{ab}^{-1}$.

proof.text: Take U_h to be the existing affineEtaleBaseChange. Its composite with inclusion is definitionally ordinary base change after inclusion, so t_h is Iso.refl. For each h use affineEtaleSiteBaseChange for covering preservation and continuity; take its canonical sheafPullback and sheafAdjunctionContinuous for L_h and a_h. The same theorem supplies PreservesFiniteLimits L_h. Assemble the families by choice for continuity and the explicit canonical constructions for the other data.

Apply the restriction-unit theorem to these U,t,L,a to obtain e and its affine section-unit formula. Extract c and its section-unit formula from etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits, restrict c to affine pairs of morphisms, and retain the formula.

Apply the composition-coherence theorem to U,t,L,a,e and the chosen full-site c with their unit formulas. This supplies gamma,d, the lift equation, the affine composition-unit equation and the restriction square. Construct the existential tuple and all conjunctions using these results together with covering preservation, continuity and finite-limit preservation from step 1.

The direct-image restriction is computed by the generic continuity/base-change statement, which is external to the sk-thm-iff route.
Adjoint uniqueness transfers the full-site inverse image to the affine-site inverse image and is not supplied by the sk-thm-iff route.
